definition.title: Write posts for your LinkedIn company page
definition.description: Write six posts for your company's LinkedIn page from your brand guide, notes and site wording, each with a brief for its card. Your coding agent makes the cards with Tin's card kit; you pick which post goes out. Nothing is posted.

prerequisites.reason: The brand guide says what the company is and how it sounds.

direction.title: Optional direction
direction.description: What this batch should cover, in a sentence or two: a launch, a feature, a theme. Tin treats it as decided.

formats_path.title: Formats file
formats_path.description: The post formats your page uses. Without the file, Tin picks formats and lists them with the batch.

style_path.title: Optional writing guide
style_path.description: A writing guide in project Files for the page's voice. Without it, Tin uses the project's writing style guide.

nodes.label: Write six posts
nodes.fact: one model call, a card brief each

nodes.label: Check each post
nodes.fact: code checks, one call fixes what they find

nodes.label: Your agent makes the cards
nodes.fact: Tin's card kit, checked before upload

nodes.label: You pick the next post
nodes.fact: nothing is posted without a pick
